visual.general_description: Light-microscopy field of a stained bone marrow aspirate smear with crowded large nucleated cells among red blood cells.
visual.detailed_description: A single unlabelled microscopy field on a white background. Numerous large round to oval nucleated cells with purple-violet nuclei, fine to finely clumped chromatin and a rim of light blue cytoplasm are crowded together, many touching. Some nuclei are indented or folded. Pink-red anucleate red blood cells fill the spaces between them, and a few smaller dark purple cells and one dark purple irregular cell are scattered at the edges. Open white background areas appear at the right and lower center. There is no scale bar, panel letter, arrow, text label, stain name or magnification printed on the image.

visual.general_description: Flow cytometry CD45 versus side scatter dot plot with color-coded labelled gates.
visual.detailed_description: A dot plot with SSC-A (x 1,000) on the horizontal axis, ticks 50 to 250, and CD45 APC-H7-A on a logarithmic vertical axis with ticks 10^2 to 10^5. Outlined gates with printed labels are Lymph (red dots, upper left), Monos (blue dots, upper middle), Blasts (green dots, middle left), Grans (purple dots, a long band extending to the right), P3 (yellow dots at the far left), CD45 neg (cyan dots in a box at the lower left) and P2 (label at the lower right, with a wide horizontal box spanning the bottom). Ungated events are gray. The Lymph label is partly overlapped by the adjacent gate. No percentages, counts or other numbers are printed besides the axis ticks.

visual.general_description: Line graph of bone marrow blast percent against weeks post treatment showing a declining trend across three markers.
visual.detailed_description: A line graph on a white background with light gridlines. The vertical axis is titled Bone marrow blasts percent with printed ticks from 0% to 50% in 5% steps; the horizontal axis is titled Weeks post treatment with printed ticks from 0 to 20 in steps of 2. A blue line connects three round markers; the markers are spaced from left to right across the plot. The line descends from the first marker to the second more steeply than from the second to the third. An upward arrow near the left edge beneath the line is labelled Day of Ara-C injection. No numeric data labels, legend or title are printed.
